questions.q: How many hours do you usually sleep?
questions.answer: Usually around seven hours on weeknights, which seems to be enough for me. At weekends I sometimes sleep a little longer to [[make up for]] the week, although I try not to overdo it.

Mostly, yes, though it varies. When my mind is calm I fall asleep quickly, but on stressful days it takes a while to switch off. I've learned that avoiding my phone before bed is [[remarkably]] effective.

questions.q: Do you take naps during the day?
questions.answer: Rarely on workdays, since there simply isn't time. On Fridays, though, I sometimes have a short nap after lunch. Even twenty minutes leaves me feeling [[refreshed]] and noticeably sharper for the rest of the day.

questions.q: What do you do when you can't fall asleep?
questions.answer: I usually get up and read something light for a while rather than lying there frustrated. Sometimes a cup of warm milk helps too. Once my mind settles, I tend to [[drift off]] fairly quickly.

questions.q: Do you think people get enough sleep nowadays?
questions.answer: Not really, particularly young people. Many stay up late on their phones or working, then wake early for work or classes. I think sleep is often treated as a [[luxury]] rather than a necessity these days.
